pullRequests.body:
Summary
Fix a stretched triangle in Novalis enhanced water on Radeon Vulkan. The baked water strip and live CPU vertices agreed, but the rendered face picked up mismatched triangle data. Fetch each vertex's barycentric weights and coarse triangle index as one integer attribute and decode the original float bits in the shader.
The fix applies to the shared enhanced-water draw path and works with existing water bakes.

The Going Commando save editor showed a weapon's version but never let you change it, so there was no way to turn on the challenge-mode Mega versions the way rac1's editor turns on golden weapons. Now there is.

commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Going Commando installed its tools and its play table (tools.c, play.c)
from crt0, after main.cpp had loaded the mods, so every mod kept a null play
table: play_status failed, the item randomizer's ticks (the vendor's stock,
Endako's own items, a level start's rewards) did nothing, and the multiplayer
mod refused to load. A constructor in entry.c, which the link keeps, installs
them first, as Ratchet & Clank's boot.c does; crt0 installs them again.
